M1 at least four correct frequency densities, accept unsimplified; may be read from an accurate graph. A1 all bar heights correct; daylight rule applied across full width. B1 bar ends at 0.5, 10.5, 20.5, 25.5, 30.5 and 50.5 with a linear scale from 0.5 to 50.5 and at least three values indicated linearly; daylight rule $0\text{ cm}\le FD\le1\text{ cm}$ vertically. Minimum: each axis uses at least half the grid. Axes may be reversed. Total: 4.
